basics.name: Srisha Bista
basics.label: Entomology Researcher
basics.summary: A passionate researcher of Entomology. Working as a Project Coordinator at SAHAS Nepal.

work.name: SAHAS Nepal
work.summary: Lead project implementation to promote climate-resilient and sustainable agricultural practices. Conduct training and field research with farmers on eco-friendly farming and integrated pest management. Strengthen community-based organizations and collaborate with government agencies, NGOs, and INGOs to align project efforts with national food security strategies.

work.name: iDE Nepal (USAID IPM Project)
work.summary: Mass production of biological control agents. Conducted field trials on parasitoid efficacy, insect-pathogen interactions, and multitrophic interaction. Supported IPM extension activities and farmer outreach programs.

education.institution: Agriculture and Forestry University, Chitwan, Nepal
education.description: Research on 'Ovipositional Preference and Management of Pulse Beetle Using Edible Oils in Chitwan', aimed to identify eco-friendly and affordable pest management strategies to reduce post-harvest loss of pulses.

education.institution: Agriculture and Forestry University, Chitwan, Nepal
education.description: Undergraduate thesis on 'Assessment of Knowledge, Perception, and Practice of Pesticide Use by Vegetable Growers in Nepal'.

awards.title: USAID Research Grant
awards.summary: Recipient of research grant for the study 'Ovipositional Preference and Management of Pulse Beetle Using Edible Oils in Chitwan, Nepal.'
